body.name: Compact buffered broad recovery class
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\kappa}=\{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}:\min_k\mathfrak m_k(p)\geq2\kappa\text{ and }\min_{\ell\in\mathcal L}\Sigma_{\ell\ell}(p)\geq2\kappa\}\), with closure taken inside the finite-parameter compatible image on the enlarged \(126\)-cell absorbing support.
